{{Quote|This is the sort of life I joined the fleet to escape.|[[Daric LaRone]]|<ref name="AN" />}}
'''Copperline''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="CE">{{CSWECite|I|139|Copperline}}</ref> located in the [[Vatha sector/Legends|Vatha sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The planet was inhabited by dirt-poor [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] and for decades<ref name="AN" /> was overrun by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. Shortly after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="CE" /> in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Fleet]] and [[Imperial Army/Legends|infantry]] had come in force and spent five [[Standard month/Legends|months]] clearing out the pirate nests that had plagued Copperline. [[10 BBY/Legends|Eight years]] later, when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] recruiters had come,<ref name="AN" /> many inhabitants joined the Imperial military service in gratitude.<ref name="CE" /> Among the volunteers was a native teenager, [[Daric LaRone]], who was fascinated by the opportunity to serve the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], although he was also motivated to a considerable extent by a desire to escape the poverty of Copperline.<ref name="AN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Copperline was first mentioned in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2007]] novel [[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']].<ref name="AN" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the [[Copperline system/Legends|Copperline star system]] in grid square K-16.<ref name="EAOC" />
